info.title: wildling - pattern based string generator
info.description: Pattern based string generator library and CLI

options.name: --check
options.description: Print generation info instead of results

options.name: --template
options.description: Load options from a JSON template file

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version
PATTERNS
# #{N} #{N-M}               digits 0-9; optional fixed or ranged length
@ @{N} @{N-M}               lowercase a-z
* *{N} *{N-M}               lowercase a-z and digits 0-9
& &{N} &{N-M}               lowercase and uppercase letters
! !{N} !{N-M}               uppercase A-Z
? ?{N} ?{N-M}               uppercase A-Z and digits 0-9
- -{N} -{N-M}               letters and digits
${'a,b',N-M}               combinations from a comma-separated word list
%{'name'} %{'name',N-M}     words from a named dictionary
\# \@ \$ ...                escape a wildcard character
TEMPLATE JSON
{
"patterns": ["Year 19##", "%{'colors'}"],
"dictionaries": {
"colors": "path/to/colors.txt",
"inline": ["red", "blue"]
},
"select": [0, 2],
"range": ["5-7"],
"check": false
}
